scheme_name: Scheme for Relief to the Un-registered Workers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a dependent of the deceased unregistered worker
The worker must be unregistered with the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Death must have occurred in an accident at a construction site or related project during the course of employment
Disability must be permanent and caused by an accident at a construction site
Disability percentage must be 50% or above for full permanent disability or 50% or below for permanent partial disability
benefits_summary: Provides ₹50,000 to dependents of unregistered workers who die in construction site accidents, and ₹20,000 or ₹10,000 for permanent (≥50%) or partial (<50%) disability respectively.
